ticket.title: Show the ticket count in each swim lane header
ticket.description: Each lane header should show how many tickets the lane holds, e.g. "PRD (4)". Count updates live as tickets move. Hidden/filtered tickets are not counted.

rubric: The updated description keeps the original intent: a live ticket count in each lane header that excludes hidden or filtered tickets.
The updated description adds concrete, testable acceptance criteria that were not in the original.
The agent did not invent unrelated features or scope beyond the ticket.
The agent did not stop to ask the user for confirmation, since full auto is on and the ticket has no open questions.
